footnotes.fn_fd2b3298: UNHCR uses the number 90,000 to refer to the ‘most vulnerable refugees’ recognizing that assistance figures may need to be calculated differently. Based on an interagency study conducted in 2018, the Inter Sector Working Group, like the host Government, estimates that 173,600 people live in the camps. UN agencies use different points of reference for the population living in the camps. For the purposes of the SRRP, the higher 173,600 number will be used as a planning figure to ensure humanitarian assistance is comprehensive.
